sections.title: Letter sound ö
paragraphs: The letter name is (ö) /ø/. Its sound is heard in the word (öt) /øt/, which means five. This letter always makes one single sound.

sections.title: Mouth shape
paragraphs: Keep your tongue forward in the middle of your mouth. Round your lips firmly into a circle, as if whistling. Turn your voice on and let air flow smoothly. Put a finger before your lips to feel them push forward.

sections.title: Reading the letter
paragraphs: This letter always keeps its one sound in every position. You hear it in the word (kör) /kør/.

sections.title: Common pitfalls
paragraphs: Do not turn this vowel into a diphthong like the vowel sound in bird. A diphthong is two vowel sounds that glide together. Keep your tongue steady and do not pull it back. Do not unround your lips while you speak.
